bug_semantics: Unauthenticated callers who know a webhook (workspaceId, webhookId) can POST JSON to /api/webhooks/trigger/:instance/:id. That body is flattened into automation trigger context, templated into EXECUTE_QUERY bindings via processObject, and executed with isAutomation:true (skipping getAuthConfig) using builder datasource credentials. Snowflake is excluded from isSQL() (only Postgres/SQL Server/MySQL/Oracle), so packages/server/src/threads/query.ts uses sdk.queries.enrichContext(..., noEscaping:true) instead of interpolateSQL, splicing attacker-controlled values into query.sql. snowflake.ts then runs this.client.execute({sqlText: query.sql}) (binds unused unless interpolateSQL produced them). Optional COLLECT + SYNC_AUTOMATIONS returns rows to the caller.
flaw_origin: 570aeecdc3f6600b4dec279d588a704b1d4c8e60 (Added Snowflake integration, Mel O'Hagan, 2022-05-30) first wrote packages/server/src/integrations/snowflake.ts executing connection.execute({sqlText: query.sql}) with no binds. Immediate parent 3a56712d621d34d23fb4924445b0b15156bee138 has no snowflake.ts. At that commit isSQL() already omitted SNOWFLAKE, so the new integration was born onto the non-parameterized enrichQueryFields/enrichContext path. 7eca8c45bee665f1ee177603ddc5e8248a6a39d9 later forwards query.bindings to the driver but does not put Snowflake in isSQL(), so interpolateSQL still never runs and sqlText remains interpolated. Not a move/squash; single-parent first-write of the sink.

reasoning: The advisory is real published CWE-89: unauthenticated webhook JSON becomes EXECUTE_QUERY parameters and is spliced into Snowflake SQL because Snowflake is not treated as isSQL. The smallest public commit that first wrote that Snowflake sqlText sink is 570aeec; the parent tree has no snowflake integration. Public webhooks and automation query execution already existed; they become this CVE only when Snowflake executes interpolated sqlText. 7eca8c45bee is an incomplete later change (Codex-named PR #19097) that forwards unused bindings; it is not the BIC. Advertised 3.40.0 does not add Snowflake to isSQL, does not route Snowflake through interpolateSQL, and still public-triggers webhooks; HEAD through v3.42.0 still omits SNOWFLAKE from isSQL. Genuinely unpatched in this clone. AI judged only on BIC 570aeec: human author/committer, no commit-object AI marker. Verdict NOT_AI, unpatched.
